name: wellnesshotel-guide
description: Search and compare wellness and spa hotels in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy (incl. South Tyrol).

interface.longDescription:
wellnesshotel.guide is an independent comparison guide for wellness and spa hotels in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Italy, including South Tyrol.

Ask for a place, region or hotel name, optionally with features such as infinity pool, thermal spa, day spa, adults only, dogs welcome, organic or medical wellness, and a minimum star rating. You get matching hotels with location, stars, the .guide Score (our editorial rating of spa, service, rooms, cuisine and sustainability) and a link to each hotel page. Ask for details on a hotel to get a short profile, or for a link to send a free, non-binding inquiry to one hotel or to several hotels in a region.

All tools are read-only. The app never books, pays or submits anything: the guest sends the inquiry on wellnesshotel.guide and the hotel replies directly. Results keep the order of our website: marked partners come first, then hotels sorted by .guide Score. The rating cannot be bought. Hotel data is in German; ChatGPT translates as needed.
defaultPrompt: Find a wellness hotel in the Allgäu where I can bring my dog
Adults-only spa hotels in South Tyrol
5-star hotels with an infinity pool in Tyrol

positive.description: Search by region with a feature filter
positive.prompt: Find a wellness hotel in the Allgäu where I can bring my dog.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with query "Allgäu" and features ["hund"]. Lists up to 5 hotels in the Allgäu with location, stars, .guide Score and a link to each hotel page on www.wellnesshotel.guide, preceded by the note on listing order.

positive.description: Search by state with adults-only filter
positive.prompt: Which adults-only spa hotels are there in South Tyrol?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with query "Südtirol" (or "South Tyrol") and features ["erwachsene"]. Returns adults-only hotels in Trentino-South Tyrol with links.

positive.description: Search with minimum stars and infinity pool
positive.prompt: Show me 5-star hotels with an infinity pool in Tyrol.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with query "Tirol", features ["infinity-pool"] and min_stars 5. Returns matching hotels in Tyrol (Austria) with links.

positive.prompt: Find wellness hotels in the Allgäu, then tell me more about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels, then get_hotel with the slug of the first result. Gives a short profile (location, spa, .guide Score) with links to the hotel page and the inquiry form.

positive.prompt: I want to ask several wellness hotels in South Tyrol about availability in February. How do I do that?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls inquiry_link with region "Südtirol". Returns a link to https://www.wellnesshotel.guide/anfrage/ with the region preselected and explains that the guest enters dates and contact details there. Nothing is sent by the app.

de-DE.subtitle: Wellnesshotels finden
de-DE.description:
wellnesshotel.guide ist ein unabhängiger Vergleich für Wellness- und Spa-Hotels in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und Italien inklusive Südtirol.

Fragen Sie nach Ort, Region oder Hotelname, auf Wunsch mit Merkmalen wie Infinity-Pool, Therme, Day Spa, Adults only, Hund willkommen, Bio oder Medical Wellness und Mindest-Sternen. Sie erhalten passende Häuser mit Lage, Sternen, dem .guide Score (unsere redaktionelle Bewertung aus Spa, Service, Zimmern, Kulinarik und Nachhaltigkeit) und dem Link zur Hotelseite. Zu jedem Haus gibt es ein Kurzporträt und den Link zur kostenlosen, unverbindlichen Anfrage an ein Hotel oder an mehrere Häuser einer Region.

Alle Funktionen lesen nur. Die App bucht nichts, bezahlt nichts und schickt nichts ab: Die Anfrage senden Sie selbst auf wellnesshotel.guide, das Hotel antwortet Ihnen direkt. Gekennzeichnete Partner stehen an der Spitze. Danach sortieren wir nach .guide Score — die Bewertung ist in keinem Fall käuflich.
